Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable.



Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud-seeding science with weather-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities.



Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and provide, and help deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you.

Rainmaker builds systems to increase precipitation and improve water availability. We combine atmospheric science, autonomous aircraft, radar and satellite observations, weather modeling, and novel sensing technologies.

Our software connects these systems, supports field operations, and turns each operation into data that improves the next one.

The role

 - Rainmaker is hiring a Software Engineer to own our production infrastructure and security.
   
   Your scope includes cloud infrastructure, deployments, observability, identity and access, secrets, vulnerability management, incident response, and recovery. You will build remote systems that work 24/7 and accommodate lost comms. Storms do not wait for business hours.

What you'll do

 - 

 - Own production infrastructure end to end, setting the standards for how services get deployed, monitored, and recovered.

 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and test infrastructure for rapid agentic development.

 - Balance rigor and security with the need for engineers to move quickly.

 - Work across software, science, aircraft engineering, and field operations.

What we're looking for

 - 

 - A software engineer with experience building production infrastructure.

 - Fast, thoughtful, autonomous, and opinionated.

 - Willing to relocate to El Segundo, CA.

 - Built and operated production systems. We care more about what you have shipped than your degree or years in the industry.

 - Deep familiarity with AWS and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Pulumi or Terraform.

 - Managed secrets and credential lifecycles in a fast-moving environment.

 - Designed or maintained zero-trust, WireGuard-based networks; we run almost everything on Tailscale.

What success looks like

 - You will understand all of Rainmaker's critical systems, data flows, access model, and largest operational and security risks and have shipped at least one material improvement. Within your first year, critical services will be easier to deploy, observe, secure, and recover. Software capabilities should scale faster than requisite operational effort.

 - 401(k) with employer matching

 - Full health coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance)

 - Relocation assistance provided (if applicable)

 - Paid parental leave for both parents

 - Lunch provided when working in-office and a fully stocked kitchenette

Supporting the Rainmakers behind the mission

Making earth more habitable is ambitious work and we want the people doing it to feel supported:

 - A stake in what we build: Meaningful stock options and the opportunity to help shape Rainmaker as an early member of the team. 

 - Support for your health: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family.
